lines: #The first bill you pay every month should be to *yourself.*
Not rent. Not your phone. Not your *wants.*
#Most people save whatever is left after spending.
That's why most people have *nothing* left.
Flip it. Save first. Spend what's *left.*
Because money you never see, is money you never *miss.*
Do it for one year, and you won't recognise your *account.*
end: Save this. Start on your next payday.
